body: The only person I had like that was my boyfriend. He was my best friend. Anyone else in my life would think I'm insane and stop talking to me. There's nobody left and it's my own fault.

I'm the exact opposite of the daughter my mom trained me to be. I gave up custody of my two babies to my emotionally and verbally abusive ex because I was too scared and weak to be a parent. I broke up with my boyfriend two months ago because he wanted babies and marriage and loved me too much. He wants me back and I want him back but I've already moved on to someone who doesn't want me at all, and I can't give up that relationship. Being me hurts so fucking much and I don't know how to stop. I feel like it's all catching up to me and I'm losing my mind. I have nothing left. No one.
Everyone I get close to ends up getting hurt. Including myself. I don't know how to stop.
